item_taken.first_six_words: Own hand, stranger's reasons: the reasoner's
item_taken.why: The case's first half, an author rereading after compaction a fence it built on purpose and cutting it as an oversight, is this item's own first illustrative case word for word, and its named edge, the reason, is this item's thing past the edge; not Summary in the seat (3), where a stand-in sits where the turns sat and the transcript restores them, since here the fence is exact and the reasons were in no transcript; not Hearsay in the window (14), where the missing fact is whose the sentence is, since here the hand is the reasoner's own and what is missing is why; not Sea room unknown (16), whose edge is ahead, since this edge is behind, closed by the compaction. The case's second half, a success metric still optimized after one of the two systems it chose between was abandoned, is held by no item of this map; it rides along as the far map's half of the case.

reasoning: The rule partitions on one axis, the readability of a trace's source: an arrangement that keeps the source readable is there (Arm's-length custody); a window in which sentences arrive flat and the source is carried only by a tag is here (Hearsay in the window). The case does not sit on that axis. Its artifact, the fence, is the reasoner's own hand, exact and complete; what lies past the edge is the reason for it, which was never written anywhere, and the failure, the deliberate exception repaired as a fix, survives even when the source is fully readable (a git blame naming the author does not restore the purpose). So the rule's there-clause is not met, since the case names no arrangement keeping anything readable, and its here-clause is not met, since the source is not what the window lacks. The second half of the case, the metric whose question died, sits off the axis for the same reason: its provenance is not in doubt, its warrant is. To decide, the rule would need a clause on the reason axis rather than the source axis: something like 'the arrangement that keeps an artifact's reasons readable beside it when it is made, the night order book, the reason written before the edge is known to be coming, is there; the artifact whose reasons were never written, met by its own maker as a stranger's, is here.' Under that widened rule the case as stated, which is the failure with no such arrangement, would stay here (no), and only the arrangement itself would cross. Under the rule as given, nothing decides, so the answer is refused rather than no.
